row.name: lti_line_items_lesson_link_key
row.where: declared and lesson_id is not null and status = 'active'

row.name: lti_line_items_assignment_link_key
row.where: declared and assignment_id is not null and status = 'active'

row.name: lti_line_items_module_idx
row.where: module_id is not null and status = 'active'

row.name: lti_line_items_class_idx
row.where: class_id is not null and status = 'active'

row.name: lti_line_items_course_check
row.value:
num_nonnulls(module_id, class_id) = 1
        and (lesson_id is null or module_id is not null)
        and (assignment_id is null or class_id is not null)

row.name: lti_line_items_link_check
row.value:
(link_id is null) = (lesson_id is null and assignment_id is null)
        and (not declared or link_id is not null)

row.name: lti_line_items_fields_check
row.value:
char_length(label) between 1 and 200 and score_maximum > 0
        and char_length(coalesce(resource_id, '')) <= 255 and char_length(coalesce(tag, '')) <= 255
        and (starts_at is null or ends_at is null or starts_at <= ends_at)

row.name: lti_scores_score_check
row.value:
(score_given is null or (score_given >= 0 and score_maximum > 0))
        and char_length(coalesce(comment, '')) <= 4000
